LESSON: LOCOMOTIVE SKILLS

Grade: PP1
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: BASIC MOTOR
Topic 12.1: Locomotive SKILLS

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Locomotive SKILLS. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Demonstrate the ability to crawl and swing for enjoyment
2. Have fun as they crawl and swing in turns activities in groups and in pairs.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Demonstrate the ability to crawl and swing for enjoyment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate the ability to crawl and swing for enjoyment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Have fun as they crawl and swing in turns activities in groups and in pairs.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to have fun as they crawl and swing in turns activities in groups and in pairs. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Locomotive SKILLS.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Locomotive SKILLS. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Locomotive SKILLS important to you?
